*Kusalattika, Cetasikaduka* (Patthana 16.17) is an Abhidhamma text belonging to the *Paṭṭhāna* division of the Pali Tipiṭaka [SuttaCentral]. Structurally, it integrates the analytical framework of the triad of wholesome states (*kusalattika*) with the dyad of mental factors (*cetasikaduka*) [SuttaCentral]. No dedicated modern translations or discussions in secondary literature are documented in the available dossier [SuttaCentral].
